name: 10-bff-auth
comment: The shop's own sign-in links, which the BFF turns into the gateway's: /auth/login?return_to=..., /auth/register, POST /auth/logout and /auth/failed. The gateway's /auth/login?registration=..., GET /auth/logout and /auth/callback fall through to 20-shop.
condition: ${((request.uri.path == '/auth/login' or request.uri.path == '/auth/register') and empty request.queryParams['registration']) or (request.uri.path == '/auth/logout' and request.method == 'POST') or request.uri.path == '/auth/failed'}
